coverage: Initial verified Bratislava selection, not a complete city agenda. Six official calendar pages and 92 linked pages were retrieved; 80 date-bearing metadata entries were screened, with selected full bodies and primary theatre, gallery and venue programmes reviewed. Source retrieval does not mean every programme was verified. Separate performances and exhibition visiting hours are not interchangeable. Some dates and categories remain sparse; November 1 has no verified individual session in this selection. Sold-out programmes and unresolved boarding locations are held. Public Telegram attempts were unavailable, not readable conversations; no Telegram imports or joining.
